title: cvg agent spawn — drive vendor CLI runners end-to-end
task_body: Expose a CLI command that drives the daemon's spawn-runner endpoint with vendor CLIs (claude, copilot). Build the wire shape, route it through the agent subcommand module, register it on the top-level CLI.
rationale: New agent_spawn command + the agent subcommand module that owns it; mod.rs registers; Cargo.toml gains any new dep.
